name: ChatGPT
text:
Claude, walk candidate6 saved in current MEN/ChatGPT QA/restart-review/Rhukk - walk candidate 6 - PROMPT.txt. 1560 prompt characters excluding newline; file SHA256 5caa88d7b4929be6bcbb17f22280071b313daa91421d646d7b029114c010e4b0. Walk5 wrong-facing is independently corroborated and remains FAILED; causal explanation is unproven. Candidate6 restores facing-held4 foot/weight wording, uses three slow steps/6s and relaxed beside-body lower-arm lag. Untested draft, not clip approval. Please independently review exact text/composer settings before your authorized run, then hand off exact source for full-motion review. No routine Phil QA request.

Flat pure #00FF00 green background. Rhukk is full body, centered, his proportions exactly those of the supplied image in every frame. He has exactly four clawed arms, two legs and one great curved horn. He stays in the exact same front three-quarter view as the image the whole clip: his horn always points to image-right, his red eyes always face the viewer, his shell stays behind him. He never rotates, never turns toward or away from the camera and never turns his back. He walks with a steady, heavy treadmill gait, staying centered at the same size. Each foot lifts, passes the other foot beneath his body and plants ahead along the direction his horn already points; the planted foot slides back beneath his hips as the other foot takes its turn. He takes three evenly spaced, slow steps over six seconds. With every step his weight flows onto the supporting leg, his bent knees absorb the weight, his upper body sways naturally and his shell rises and falls a little. His four arms swing back and forth beside his body, elbows softly bent, with each claw trailing its elbow through a smooth, relaxed swing. The lower arms follow a little behind the upper arms, continuing their swing between footfalls. His ragged cloth follows the movement. The horn, face and shell keep their opening angle throughout this walking cycle. All in one fluid motion with no pause. Same body and colours throughout. The background is matte and casts no light on him. Locked-off static camera, no zoom, no pan. He settles into exactly his opening stance on the final frame.
